_readme: Canonical registry of primary sources, clustering frameworks, and licensing terms for the Africa Data Atlas & Cartographic Observatory.

platform.title: Africa Data Atlas & Cartographic Observatory
platform.subtitle: An interactive atlas of geography, indicators and historical trade flows

author.name: ZéLuis F. Correia
author.statement: ZéLuis F. Correia is the author of all SVG maps and the Ethnic Tree Visualization and SVG. Unless stated otherwise, all graphics and visualizations have the same author.

code.scope: Application source code, React/TypeScript components, build scripts, and documentation framework

assets.scope: All SVG maps (public/africa-final.svg, src/data/africaFinalGeometry.ts), the Ethnic Tree Visualization and SVG (src/data/authenticEthnicTreeSvg.ts, src/data/africaliaMasterTreeData.ts), and all graphics and visualizations unless stated otherwise

slaveVoyages.name: Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database

observed.description: Documented voyages recorded directly in surviving archival logbooks, port ledgers, manifests, and vice-admiralty court records.

imputed.description: Documented voyages with missing values (captives embarked/disembarked, vessel tonnage, rig) filled in by statistical imputation.

estimated.description: Continental-level demographic models accounting for unrecorded voyages across the full 1501–1866 transatlantic period.

slaveVoyages.citation: SlaveVoyages Consortium. (2024). Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database (2024.1 release). https://www.slavevoyages.org/

ethnicGroups.name: List of contemporary ethnic groups of Africa

clusteringFrameworkReferences.authors: Bird, N., Ormond, L., Awah, P., Caldwell, E. F., Connell, B., Elamin, M., ... & Hellenthal, G.
clusteringFrameworkReferences.title: Dense sampling of ethnic groups within African countries reveals fine-scale genetic structure and extensive historical admixture
clusteringFrameworkReferences.note: Cited for clustering framework only (how genetic clusters relate to ethnicity, language, and geography). The Atlas does not reproduce biological samples or genotype data.

clusteringFrameworkReferences.authors: Tishkoff, S. A., Reed, F. A., Friedlaender, F. R., Ehret, C., Ranciaro, A., Froment, A., ... & Williams, S. M.
clusteringFrameworkReferences.title: The genetic structure and history of Africans and African Americans
clusteringFrameworkReferences.note: Cited for clustering framework only (how genetic clusters relate to ethnicity, language, and geography). The Atlas does not reproduce biological samples or genotype data.
